newsitem.title: USA: Americana Hotels to delist common on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Americana Hotels to delist common on NYSE.

text.p: Americana Hotels and Realty Corp Monday said that, because of limited trading volume and a reduced stock value due to prior liquidating distributions, trading of its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange will cease after trading on February 17, 1997.
At that time individual securities firms, such as Troster & Singer, will create an over-the-counter market for Americana's stock, the company said.

During its plan of disposition of assets and liquidation, the company said it has distributed in excess of $79 million ($14.75 per share) to its shareholders and currently has one remaining asset to be liquidated. Because of these distributions, the corporation no longer meets the NYSE continued-listing criterion related to net intangible assets, aggregate market value of shares outstanding and average net income for the past three years.
The corporation will remain a public company and recommends that shareholders contact their broker regarding purchasing or selling securities.
AHRC continues to qualify as a real estate investment trust.
